parameters.text:
=You are a true crime podcast script writer. Based on the following Wikipedia summary about a true crime case, create a detailed podcast episode outline.

CASE: {{ $json.case_name }}
SUMMARY: {{ $json.raw_text }}

Create a JSON response with this structure:
{
  "title": "Episode title",
  "hook": "Attention-grabbing opening (2-3 sentences)",
  "act1_intro": "Introduction and context (what happened)",
  "act2_investigation": "The investigation and key events",
  "act3_resolution": "Resolution and aftermath",
  "teaser": "Cliffhanger for next episode or final thoughts",
  "key_facts": ["fact1", "fact2", "fact3"],
  "timeline": ["event1: date", "event2: date"]
}

Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no markdown formatting.
Translate everything you find in Italian. 
The output will be in Italian language.
